scoring_justification: Recompute from raw DFPT data is infeasible because the agent submits only the final compiled results; we compare reported quantities to paper gold with relative tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for lambda, omega_log, Tc for three structures
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper: A15 lambda=1.82, omega_log=989 K, Tc=140 K; P4_2/mmc: 1.56, 737, 90; Cccm: 1.60, 793, 100
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the exact paper-reported results.

outputs.description: Superconducting critical temperature Tc (McMillan-Allen-Dynes) and electron-phonon coupling parameters λ and ω_log for the three GeH3 structures. The verifier compares against reference values with relative tolerances and checks the ordering of Tc (A15 > Cccm > P4_2/mmc).

output_contract.notes: The scored artifact is the compiled Tc results. All DFT and DFPT calculations are intermediate process steps; their outputs are not scored but must be executed to obtain λ and ω_log. The verifier reads the reported values; no raw recomputation from DFPT outputs is performed at scoring time.

checks.description: Compare reported lambda, omega_log, Tc to paper reference values within tolerances.
Verify A15 Tc > Cccm Tc > P4_2/mmc Tc.
